message:
The build environment is isolated - each command runs in a fresh container. Let me combine the build and run in a single command.

<｜｜DSML｜｜execute_bash>
<parameter=command>cd /workspace && bash build.sh 'cd /gt/_work/src && mkdir -p build && cd build && cmake -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER=clang++ -DCMAKE_C_COMPILER=clang -DCMAKE_CXX_FLAGS="-fsanitize=address -g -O1" -DCMAKE_C_FLAGS="-fsanitize=address -g -O1" .. 2>&1 | tail -20'</parameter>
